title: MODFLOW6 Typed API Binding

canonical_reconciliation.head: 1604b89e6bebf6436dcd2718b8e150bf909d8a01
canonical_reconciliation.delta_since_f_gc33_reconciliation: 24 commits touching only publication experiment/workflow/evidence files; no F-GC30/F-GC31/F-GC33 dependency source changes

external_semantics_evidence.contract: MODFLOW6 API package exposes NODELIST, RHS, HCOF, MAXBOUND and NBOUND pointers; NODELIST uses MODFLOW/Fortran 1-based node ids and the API package arrays are explicitly mutable

qualified_contract: groundwater_cell_id, package_slot and modflow_node_id are independent explicit identities
package_slot is 1-based and the active slots must form exactly 1..N so NBOUND cannot activate an unintended gap
F-GC33 terms are matched to bindings by groundwater_cell_id rather than caller array order
publication validates the complete binding set before the first write
successful publication writes NODELIST, HCOF and RHS for active slots and then sets NBOUND
failed publication leaves NODELIST, HCOF, RHS and NBOUND unchanged
multiple distinct coupling cells may use distinct package slots that reference the same explicit MODFLOW node id without coefficient collapsing
inactive package tail beyond NBOUND remains untouched
the module has no XMI, MODFLOW solve, Ribasim or SWAP commit dependency
exclusions: XMI address discovery or pointer acquisition
next_permitted_action: Independent/admission review of the exact F-GC34 typed binding envelope, or a separately bounded XMI pointer/timing adapter that acquires NODELIST/HCOF/RHS/MAXBOUND/NBOUND addresses and invokes this already-qualified publisher without taking over MODFLOW6 solve orchestration.
